description: Create a watchlist on the signed-in account, or add bonds to one of its watchlists, and optionally make a read-only public link to share. Call only after the user asked for it. Bonds are matched to the catalog first: unresolved inputs are listed and not saved. Up to 100 bonds per call and per watchlist; it never removes bonds. Billing: free; consumes no calculation or read units. Basic accounts keep their watchlist limits, and a new public link needs Pro.

description.description: One line about the new watchlist.

identifiers.description: Bonds to add, 1 to 100: ISINs, CUSIPs or tickers such as "YPFDAR 8.5 29". ISINs are safest.

list_id.description: Add to this watchlist, from bondterminal_list_watchlists. Omit to create a new one.

name.description: Name of a new watchlist. Required when list_id is omitted.

share.description: Also make a read-only public link. A new link needs Pro.

name: bondterminal_save_watchlist

added.description: Bonds this call added; bonds already on the list are not counted.

ambiguous.description: Inputs that matched several lines; identifier is the line saved.

unresolved.description: Inputs that matched no bond; nothing was saved for them.

publicUrl.description: Read-only public link, when the watchlist is shared.

url.description: The owner's page; it needs the owner's sign-in.

title: Save a watchlist
